method.canvas: 1600x900 px; PPTX EMU scaled to canvas
method.housekeeping: Template credit, font list, resource and how-to slides are removed before measuring.
method.roles: First kept slide is the cover, last is the closing; other slides with <=4 short texts, no photos and a >=44px headline are title slides; the rest are content slides.
method.ourBindings: Deck JSON is measured on its preview slides with the studio sample copy; image slots count as photos.
